pro red_get_fpi_sep,fpi,fpi_wav=fpi_wav ; Adapted from Goran's script ; Calculate the cavity separation so both peaks are ; aligned at fpi.w0 ; It replaces the nominal value from the structure fpi ; ; hre alignment ; if keyword_set(fpi_wav) then w0=fpi.fpi_wav else w0=fpi.w0 ; nhr=long(0.5d0+fpi.shr/(w0/2.d0)) fpi.shr=nhr*w0/2.d0 ; ; lre alignment ; nlr=long(0.5d0+fpi.slr/(w0/2.d0)) fpi.slr=nlr*w0/2.d0 ; return end
